note: A broad, maintained catalog of rendering treatments. Genre, mood, era, clothing and composition can be combined with any style.

styles.name: Anime
styles.prompt: Original anime illustration with expressive eyes, clean contour lines, clear cel shading, and vivid but controlled colors.

styles.name: Manga ink
styles.prompt: Black-and-white manga illustration with expressive ink contours, variable line weight, screentone shading, and crisp page-art contrast.

styles.name: Chibi
styles.prompt: Original chibi character illustration with a small body, larger head, compact features, clean outlines, and playful proportions.

styles.name: Comic ink
styles.prompt: Bold comic illustration with confident black ink contours, graphic shadows, restrained halftone texture, and punchy color blocks.

styles.name: Graphic novel
styles.prompt: Graphic-novel character art with dramatic composition, expressive brush-ink shadows, nuanced facial acting, and cinematic color grading.

styles.name: Storybook
styles.prompt: Warm storybook character illustration with gentle shapes, tactile brushwork, soft light, and a welcoming narrative feel.

styles.name: Flat vector
styles.prompt: Clean flat-vector character illustration with simplified geometric shapes, solid color areas, crisp edges, and minimal shading.

styles.name: Pixel art
styles.prompt: Deliberate pixel art with a consistent pixel grid, limited palette, stepped edges, and readable silhouette; no smooth gradients.

styles.name: Line art
styles.prompt: Precise character line art with confident contour hierarchy, sparse internal detail, white negative space, and no painted shading.

styles.name: Pencil sketch
styles.prompt: Graphite pencil character sketch with visible construction strokes, varied pressure, natural cross-hatching, and textured paper.

styles.name: Charcoal
styles.prompt: Expressive charcoal portrait with smudged tonal masses, lifted highlights, rough paper grain, and strong light-dark structure.

styles.name: Watercolor
styles.prompt: Traditional watercolor illustration with translucent pigment blooms, textured cold-press paper, soft edges, and visible brush variation.

styles.name: Gouache
styles.prompt: Opaque gouache character painting with matte layered color, visible brush edges, rich midtones, and subtle paper texture.

styles.name: Oil painting
styles.prompt: Original oil-painted character portrait with layered impasto brushwork, warm glazing, dimensional light, and canvas texture.

styles.name: Soft pastel
styles.prompt: Soft-pastel character portrait with powdery color transitions, textured paper tooth, loose strokes, and gentle edges.

styles.name: Ink wash
styles.prompt: Monochrome ink-wash character portrait with expressive brush strokes, diluted tonal washes, absorbent paper, and generous negative space.

styles.name: Risograph
styles.prompt: Risograph character print with limited spot inks, slight registration offset, grainy dot texture, and bold poster-like shapes.

styles.name: Woodcut
styles.prompt: Woodcut character print with carved high-contrast marks, irregular grain, directional hatching, and restrained hand-printed color.

styles.name: Screen print
styles.prompt: Hand-pulled screen-print character poster with a few flat ink layers, slight registration texture, sharp silhouettes, and saturated color.

styles.name: Pop art
styles.prompt: Pop-art character portrait with bold primary-color blocks, clear black outlines, enlarged halftone dots, and punchy graphic contrast.

styles.name: Art Nouveau
styles.prompt: Original Art Nouveau-inspired character illustration with flowing organic lines, botanical framing, decorative curves, and muted jewel tones.

styles.name: Art Deco
styles.prompt: Original Art Deco-inspired character poster with geometric symmetry, stepped forms, elegant metallic accents, and streamlined 1920s design cues.

styles.name: Editorial collage
styles.prompt: Layered editorial cut-paper collage with torn edges, printed textures, overlapping colored paper, and purposeful negative space.

styles.name: Paper cut
styles.prompt: Layered paper-cut character art with crisp cut edges, stacked colored sheets, subtle cast shadows, and simple sculptural depth.

styles.name: 3D animation
styles.prompt: Polished original 3D animated character render with modeled volume, soft studio lighting, expressive features, and tactile materials.

styles.name: Low-poly 3D
styles.prompt: Stylized low-poly 3D character with visibly faceted geometry, simplified materials, clean silhouette, and coherent studio lighting.

styles.name: Claymation
styles.prompt: Handmade claymation character with sculpted clay texture, slight fingerprints, physical miniature sets, and warm stop-motion lighting.

styles.name: Photorealistic
styles.prompt: Natural photorealistic adult portrait with believable skin texture, real fabric, anatomically credible hands, and documentary light.

styles.name: Cinematic portrait
styles.prompt: Cinematic character portrait with motivated practical lighting, gentle film grain, controlled depth of field, and emotional realism.

styles.name: Fashion editorial
styles.prompt: Fashion-editorial character photograph with intentional pose, polished studio lighting, tactile garments, refined framing, and magazine-level finish.
